## Dear ENFJ Partner: Why This Handbook Exists

Welcome to your official field manual! Relationships rarely come with user instructions, but high-performance, neurodiverse human beings like **Chris** definitely require one.

If you have ever found yourself asking:
* *"Why did he say 'yes' to something on Tuesday and completely forget it by Saturday?"*
* *"Why does he freeze up and stop communicating when I get intense or upset?"*
* *"Why does our physical intimacy feel stalled, even though we love each other?"*
* *"How can I get him to talk to me without walking into a wall of silence?"*

**This book was written for YOU.** 

It pulls back the curtain on how Chris's mind actually works: the intersection of his **ENFP-T heart**, his **ADHD dopamine engine**, and his **Systems Builder intellect**.
